articles.title: The Pixel Camera app is crashing on de-Googled Android phones thanks to a new font.
articles.description:
The issue is caused by a font in the latest update to the app (version 10.x) that’s only available through Google Play Services. As a result, it’s crashing or simply failing to launch on phones running GrapheneOS and other “de-Googled” versions of Android, reports Android Authority.
[Link: The Pixel Camera app now requires Play Services for the silliest of reasons (APK teardown) | https://www.androidauthority.com/pixel-camera-play-services-requirement-reason-3609555/ | Android Authority]
